name: DirichletOnDirichlet

args.name: a1
args.description: The concentration per component for weights

args.name: a2
args.description: The concentration per component for values

title: Dirichlet-distributed component values and weights
description: Draws a discrete distribution with n components. Its weights are drawn from SymmetricDirichlet(n,a1) and, independently, its component values from SymmetricDirichlet(n,a2). Each vector sums to one. Used by ASRV.Free to construct relative rates. Sampling is supported; density evaluation is not implemented.
